_about: Tie-breaks between Sports-Reference (sr) and uconnhuskies.com schedule archive (official) for disputed game facts, using independent contemporaneous sources. truth = adjudicated value; winner = which side it matches.

sources.quote: Sat Nov 25 vs. UConn Anchorage, Alaska L Loss 81-95
Nov. 25: Connecticut 95, Auburn 81

decisions.note: Host (UAA) Shootout history and Auburn's archive both give 95-81. SR's own 1989-90 opponent season total (2,446) is exactly 10 below the sum of its schedule opp scores (2,456), consistent with 91 being an SR typo for 81.

sources.quote: Sat Nov 25 vs. UConn Anchorage, Alaska L Loss 81-95
Nov. 25: Connecticut 95, Auburn 81

decisions.note: Second-round (consolation) game of the 1989 Great Alaska Shootout was Saturday Nov 25; UConn site shifts both Alaska games after the opener by one day.

sources.quote: Connecticut 63, Florida State 60 11/26/1989, Great Alaska Shootout, Anchorage, Alaska

decisions.note: FSU box-score archive (attendance 3,179) and the host's Shootout history both date it Sunday Nov 26; only the title game was Nov 27.
